description: Complete guide to Kimberley, Northern Cape: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Kimberley is a city in Northern Cape with a population of 225,000. The Diamond City, famous for the Big Hole and its central role in South Africa’s diamond rush history. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 300 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
